issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a no-argument method returning an int, but the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) which takes a boolean parameter. This parameter mismatch means the implementation does not match the specified method signature students are expected to implement (and will break tests or cause confusion about which behavior is required).
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the implementation to provide the no-argument signature expected by the specification: add public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() that returns the total number of students (including guest students if that is the intended behavior). If the boolean variant is still desired, keep it as an overload (e.g., getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests)) but ensure the no-arg method exists and delegates to the boolean overload or otherwise implements the specified behavior so it matches the UML and tests.
